budgetUnit: decimal bytes (KB = 1000 bytes; stricter than illustrate.ts KiB budgets)
method: Existing decoded RGBA, no resize/crop/draw/alpha quantization. cwebp 1.6.0 drawing preset, exact, alpha_q 100, alpha_filter fast, q95 (q90 retries), m4, pass6, sharp_yuv; binary size target subtracts alpha payload. Lossless WebP also tried; candidates larger than source rejected.
qa: CPU composites follow global.css and theme tokens; paper multiply and cinema invert/contrast/screen/opacity, physical-tone exception retained for light/shadow and Moon figures. Every candidate compared at 420 px, 840 px, and a 200px source patch enlarged to 400px (2× native); paper and cinema. Detail patch maximizes visible RGB difference. Automated SSIM screening plus visual review; accepted candidates preserve all alpha samples exactly. No browser/desktop used.
